The '''Bresallis system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Cadma sector/Legends|Cadma sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="AOC" /> that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Bresallis]].
